title: Endurain viewer fed by RunnerUp WebDAV exports
objective: Stand up self-hosted Endurain behind the existing Caddy edge and import RunnerUp activities into it, primarily over WebDAV from the phone with an adb pull as fallback. Endurain is a VIEWER only: screen-locker's workout gate keeps reading the phone over adb and is not modified, because a WebDAV drop folder is spoofable by anything that can write to ~/cloud and must never become a screen-unlock authority. Success means real activities from the phone are visible in Endurain, importing twice never creates a duplicate, and screen-locker still passes its full suite.
acceptance_criteria: Endurain reachable at https://endurain.kuhy.duckdns.org with a valid Let's Encrypt certificate
At least 4 real RunnerUp activities imported and visible, with correct distance and duration
Re-running the importer over already-imported files creates ZERO new activities
The .gpx and .tcx of a single run import as ONE activity, not two
The seeded admin/admin login is rejected before the service is ever published
The phone-facing WebDAV credential cannot read ~/cloud/Keepass or gdrive_backups
screen-locker's full test suite still passes at 100% coverage
out_of_scope: Full history backfill out of RunnerUp's SQLite DB (the phone holds only 5 files)
Patching RunnerUp to add background auto-upload (it has none by design)
verifier: pre-commit run --files <changed>; pytest python_pkg/endurain_import/tests/ (52 tests, 100% branch coverage); systemctl --user start endurain-import.service; psql count against endurain-postgres; screen-locker pytest suite (1090 tests)
